GraceTechnology.Language: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; final stack choices are open
GraceTechnology.Runtime: Static files served by any web host; no server-side runtime. Build and checks are Python 3 scripts under portal/tools. Publishing uses the Rust tool aicc-deploy under deploy/, built offline with the installed cargo toolchain.
GraceTechnology.Framework: Custom Python static builder using markdown-it-py and Mermaid CLI. Language-specific source trees feed one stable sitemap and independent en/ru rendering; shared authored chrome remains in JSON.
GraceTechnology.TestingStack: Python unittest language-source and renderer fixtures; canonical-source hash and translation validation; static link, anchor, asset and language checks; deterministic rebuild. The deploy tool verifies its published manifest against the served site.
GraceTechnology.Observability: None for this source repository; the published site's hosting analytics are a deployment decision.

OperationalConstraints.Constraint: Use existing host tools; do not require credentials or model inference for build and check.
Generated agent projections under .claude and .agents are replaceable output from dev-pipe, not authority.
